statements.statement: FY2027 capital program totals $1,830,000, funded by raise-and-appropriate, the special purpose stabilization fund, and free cash
FY2027 capital program funded in part by $991,627 from free cash
Tier 1 override appropriation figure is $2,354,000, proposed to round up to $2.4 million for the ballot
Tier 2 override appropriation figure is $3,245,245, proposed to round up to $3.3 million for the ballot
Board finalized override ballot amounts at $2.4 million for tier 1 and $3.3 million for tier 2
Board voted to include the two-tier Proposition 2.5 override question on the annual town election ballot
A board member expressed serious concerns about the affordability and sustainability of both override tiers, favoring a balanced budget with no new positions
Special appropriation of $121,800 from certified free cash for TC Pasio decommissioning costs (article M1)
Appropriate $250,000 of free cash to the general stabilization fund (article Q1)
Appropriate $250,000 of free cash to the health insurance special purpose stabilization fund (article Q2)
Funding the fire department's fourth shift required extensive cuts across several other departments, part of prioritizing rather than adding positions

warnings.prediction: the town is heading for some rough financial years ahead
